scope: Wireframe-review consumption profile; not a new Ultimate Tokens export format

foregroundDependencies.label: --ui-label
foregroundDependencies.rule: Rebind all used descendant roles to readable foregrounds when changing the surface context; container color alone is insufficient.

overlay.geometry: Widget margin/radius2n (padding subtracts border); anchor gutter n/2; bounded viewport and scrolling content.

popover.semantics: Labelled native auto popover for supplementary content; destination links use navigation-menu contract
popover.geometry: Card padding=3margin; control radius includes presentation factor/scale; anchor gap=gutter/2; viewport bounded, overflowing content scrolls
popover.construction: Unique popover id, popovertarget button and explicit anchor-name/position-anchor pair. Put flow__root inside the panel, never override the closed popover display.
popover.behavior: Native opening, light dismissal and Escape; provide Close for longer content. Native semantics, no menu role or initializer.

spacing.ownership: Immediate parent owns content gap; direct child margins reset; nested semantic groups need no surface. Card margin is 3u; fixed control slots retain compact geometry. Major groups use 3u (same as card padding), fields 2u, related content 1u.

layoutClasses.page__root: Outer page only: 4u margin, separate from page-flow gaps; nested cards/groups do not repeat it.

headingContexts.content: data-type-context=content explicitly restores editorial headings; nested product containers reset their context
headingContexts.semantics: Keep h1-h6 document hierarchy independent of visual scale

colorNotation.styling: Prefer semantic var() references over literals

color.purpose: Raw ramps supply palette values; semantic roles bind UI meaning and paired foregrounds to scheme.
color.when: Use exported semantic surface/text/action/status pairs for interfaces. Use raw ramps for palette inspection or an explicitly designed role mapping.
color.notFor: Do not choose a raw step merely because it looks close, assume light and dark differ, or derive foreground contrast from token names alone.

typography.purpose: Voice/font and role-scale declarations separate product controls/headings from editorial reading.
typography.when: Use UI roles inside cards and product containers; use an explicit content context for editorial sections. Keep family, weight, size and line-height together.
typography.notFor: Do not apply the editorial heading scale to every h1-h6 or scale the whole interface with transforms.

geometry.purpose: Context resolves control height, margin, icon, text and radius together across tier/scale/size.
geometry.when: Inherit context and change only intended axes. Card margin is 3u, major content groups 3u, fields 2u, related content 1u.
geometry.notFor: Do not assign independent pixel dimensions to each control part or add padded cards solely because markup is nested.

layout.purpose: Layout declarations supply composition spacing and alignment primitives.
layout.when: The immediate layout parent owns spacing; use page, section, field and inline relationships at their proper scope.
layout.notFor: Do not stack child margins on a parent gap or treat inline gaps and section spacing as interchangeable.

profile.purpose: Wireframe aliases and component-scoped variables consume the supplied foundations.
profile.when: Use profile surface/ink/label roles and component geometry in the declared component context. Consult selector scope before interpreting a default.
profile.notFor: Do not present an unresolved component variable as a missing global default or rebind only body text when changing an inverse surface.

--ph-source.purpose: Representative glyph source; each icon supplies its own mask.

--ui-flow-gap.purpose: Default flow gap; spacing attribute changes the relationship.

--ui-target-min.purpose: Choice-context minimum target declaration; inspect the component frame and label for actual pointer area.

--ui-switch-clearance.purpose: Switch-local clearance; derives from inherited geometry.

--ui-switch-height.purpose: Switch-local height; derives from inherited geometry.

--ui-switch-width.purpose: Switch-local width; derives from inherited geometry.
